name: Malian
description: Malian was a planet located in the Malian system in the Expansion Region. At one point after the Battle of Yavin, Killaen Chamat had a force vision, leading Chamat, Codo Keburr, and Omi Vass to search a temple on Malian for a holocron.
lead_paragraphs: Malian was a planet located in the Malian system in the Expansion Region. At one point after the Battle of Yavin, Killaen Chamat had a force vision, leading Chamat, Codo Keburr, and Omi Vass to search a temple on Malian for a holocron.
